title: Your Remitly App Now Pays Businesses Around the World
summary: Use the same Remitly account you already have to pay directly to businesses, providing one more way Remitly is here for wherever life takes you.
body_markdown:
*Use the same Remitly account you already have to pay directly to businesses, providing one more way Remitly is here for wherever life takes you.*


When you or your family needs to pay tuition straight to the school in Mumbai, a contractor building your parent’s new kitchen, or a medical bill for your sister, the money often goes through two steps. You send it to them, then they pay the business. That means an extra handoff and extra time, and the money changes hands one more time than it needs to.


With Remitly, you can pay businesses abroad directly and skip the middle step. Pay businesses in minutes from the same Remitly app you already use to send money internationally, so loved ones no longer have to make the payment.


It’s simple. Add the business as a recipient, enter its details and send. You don’t need a new account or another app to manage.


Business payments are available in 30 send countries to 165 receive countries, with more on the way.


Paying a business is now one more way Remitly helps you take care of your financial life and the people who matter most, wherever they are.


Ready to send? Download the[Remitly app](https://www.remitly.com/us/en?kw=remitly&cpn=244948518&g_acctid=246-442-0064&g_campaign=USA-Global_EN_Brand_Prospecting_LF_70030&g_campaignid=244948518&g_adgroupid=79112931114&g_adid=363130722951&g_keyword=remitly&g_keywordid=kwd-62287121012&g_network=g&utm_source=google&utm_medium=Direct&utm_term=&utm_content=&utm_campaign=USA-Global_EN_Brand_Prospecting_LF_70030&kpid=363130722951&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=244948518&gbraid=0AAAAADPxcJzAC1HAzR1U3XIfjZVzshw-G&gclid=CjwKCAjwlY3WBhANEiwApsNrLVWQ4aZviTPag6Pf57I5SO7Y8hW9RUXPlMYPyDzArhZ-DOK9bL6tyBoCw4IQAvD_BwE) today.
